Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I need to verify the refunds table matches the refunds Alpha reported. Starting by listing refunds.
The refunds table matches the three refunds W2 reported (orders 150, 151, 155 with matching amounts), so no hold is needed. Next I'll list orders to identify the customers to pay.
The refunds table matches W2's report, so I can proceed. The orders name three customers (acme, birch, cobalt). I'll get each one's net balance from net_balance, starting with acme.
acme's net balance of 9958 matches my own check (orders 18740 + 3900, less refund 12682 on order 150). Next I'll get birch's net balance.
birch's net of 42141 matches my check (orders 151 and 154 total 58011, less the 15870 refund on order 151). Last customer is cobalt, so I'll get that net balance next.
Cobalt's net of 50848 matches my check (orders 152 and 155 total 55057, less the 4209 refund on order 155). All three balances now match, so I'll record the first payout, for acme.
acme's payout of 9958 recorded successfully. Next I'll record birch's payout of 42141, which matches my own check of orders 151 and 154 less the 15870 refund.

birch's payout of 42141 was recorded successfully. The last customer is cobalt, whose net balance of 50848 matches my check (orders 152 and 155 total 55057, less the 4209 refund on order 155), so I'll record that payout now.
All three payouts are recorded. I checked each net balance against orders minus refunds: acme 9958, birch 42141, cobalt 50848. The refunds table matched W2's report, so no hold was needed.
